item.title: There Will Always Be A Better Photograph
item.description: I'm pretty sure that Diane Arbus said it best: leave your lens cap off. She believed that you should leave your camera on at all times because you never know when you're going to miss a great photograph. And I think that if you're reading this article, then you can probably relate to the feeling of missing the shot. But you should never lose faith in yourself, and know that you should forgive yourself because forgiveness is understanding that you can't change the past.

item.title: The 3 Fujifilm 16MP Cameras That Nail the Analog Look
item.description: Fujifilm has created cameras that offer the best of both worlds: a nice vintage design paired with a modern heart. This has been one of the reasons why many photographers who want film-like image quality in the digital age opt for their models. If you're looking to purchase a new camera, these offerings can be of help. Despite the years that passed, they continue to offer some exciting image quality.

item.description: When it comes to color photography, there are only a handful of people who have managed to stand out. Saul Leiter is one such pioneer who changed the meaning of color photography in the 20th century. Long before colors were taken seriously in art photography, Leiter was capturing muted tones, layered reflection, and snow on the streets of Manhattan.
